marta: Heads-up — legal asked for a controlled way to inspect full request/response for a small set of enterprise customers for debugging (with consent). Can we prototype a route-level "inspect mode" that overrides sampling/redaction for specified routes/accounts?

jason: We can, but two big constraints: (1) must be auditable (who flipped it, for how long), (2) mustn't leak beyond allowed sessions.

liam: From privacy: explicit customer opt-in + signed consent artifact stored in audit log. Any inspect sessions must be timeboxed and require SSO+2FA confirmation.

ophelia: UX note — in Console we should surface a single toggle per route + an expiration datetime and link to the consent record. Not a global toggle.

marta: Implementation idea: route config field "inspect_override": {"accounts": [acct_ids], "expires_at": ts, "reason": str, "approved_by": user}. We should also emit an "inspect.session" event into telemetry.

jason: Agree. Runtime side: mark request context as INSPECT which short-circuits sampling and redaction hooks, but still goes through tokenization and encrypted storage. We should add a fast path that adds a header for downstream logs: X-Inspect-Session: <id>.

liam: Important: even in inspect mode we should keep PII protection for unrelated downstream services. Only the core audit-store can hold raw payloads, encrypted with customer-specific KMS key. No raw payloads to third-party vendors.

ophelia: UX question — how does the engineer request an inspect? Do they open a support ticket or self-serve in Console?

marta: Proposal: self-serve for customer admins (requires uploaded consent doc), otherwise SRE/sales ops create sessions on behalf of customers. All actions create an immutable audit entry.

jason: For rollout, suggest a canary: start with internal beta accounts -> 2 customers -> expand. Add a feature flag in the console and a separate ops-only API to create sessions. infra-bot: canary rollout created: rollout-id=rb-2026-61, cohort=[internal-beta].

liam: Redaction nuance: we still want optional partial-redaction presets (hash IDs, mask digits) so inspect sessions can choose levels: raw, hashed, masked. Raw only with explicit legal-approved consent.

marta: Good point. Add UI radio: Raw (legal only), Hashed (default), Masked (PII masked). Document cryptographic hashing rules: salt per-customer, rotate salt every 30d, store salt envelopes in HSM.
